workload.indexing: EXIF progress absent and decisions ready before measured controls; one selected photo.
workload.cacheState: Same route warmed before each measured phase; no assertion that every request is a RAM hit.

limits: Synthetic repeated gradients lack representative shooting EXIF and RAW diversity.
Native cards reserve an edit-status line; equal density and wheel inputs expose different photo counts. Do not infer an isolated renderer percentage or equal work per input.
Sequential phases and process histories differ; memory samples during recording/finalization are not comparable whole-session peaks or cache budgets.
Scripted input and final accessibility inspection add work; stall diagnostics are potential hangs, not confirmed dropped frames or physical-trackpad latency.
Incomplete/locked attempts and the withdrawn stable-host variant are excluded; the measured root-host implementation plus focus restoration is retained.
AX snapshots can omit labels after background scrolling in both baseline and native implementations; broad VoiceOver acceptance remains open.
